scope: Actual process_job on isolated clone of current 44-video library; each trial adds one duplicate content video. Qwen and frame models resident after serial warmup. No HTTP transfer, queue wait or online query contention.

retrieval_scope.text_result: FAISS Top10 segment records and scores
retrieval_scope.image_result: Top10 regions and Top5 distinct videos from top100 regions, including times/boxes/scores
retrieval_scope.face_result: All candidates at threshold 0.45, times and scores

memory_notes: RSS is sum over benchmark parent and descendants, including shared-page double counting; live server excluded.
Cross-process USS is denied by macOS and is unavailable; not reported as zero.

MPS counters are sampled in Qwen, frame and OWLv2 model processes at 100ms; sums aligned by timestamps. Tensor allocation and driver reserved memory overlap and must not be added to RSS or each other.
MPS allocator metrics do not include all CoreML allocations. System available memory and swap include unrelated processes; existing swap does not imply every byte was created by this test.
Peaks are sampled, not exact hardware peaks.
method_notes: Three scheduling modes x torch CPU intra-op threads 1/2/4; 3 warm repetitions per cell with rotated/reversed order (recorded); one initial serial warmup excluded. This is not a fully counterbalanced positional design.
Same original process_job and 35.44s media; actual thread count recorded at each child request. OMP_NUM_THREADS and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS environment remain 1; no production edits.
IORegistry Device Utilization % is whole-device observational sampling; includes unrelated applications, no per-process attribution, no claimed exclusive access.
vm_stat counters are whole-system interval deltas. Swap rates do not isolate this job. Sample interval is approximately 0.5s plus measurement cost.

Existing Tensor.cpu on MPS and torch.mps.synchronize wrapped for CPU-visible blocking duration; includes outstanding compute, copies, scheduling; not pure GPU queue wait. No extra synchronizations added.
Full-mode join and bounded producer/consumer queue waits include application-level waiting. Different wait categories/processes overlap; do not add to obtain total delay.
Metal exact queue/compute trace unavailable: xctrace requires full Xcode; powermetrics requires admin password. No privilege changes attempted.

Background host samples before each trial; no unrelated apps closed or production service stopped. Formal resident models remain loaded while the isolated experiment owns another set, so memory pressure is not identical to normal production reuse.
Fixed-query consistency regression, not independent retrieval accuracy; model resident timings exclude first load and HTTP transfer/queue wait.

Initial attempt is excluded entirely because a main-thread-only setting did not update existing encoding worker threads. Valid rerun sets and checks counts inside executing threads; sampled result-return and synchronize calls assert actual settings.

service.message: 全部已入库视频支持 Qwen 片段检索

cpu_preprocessor_followup.scope: CPU-only fast image processor on identical decoded pixels, three frames; not end-to-end indexing nor accuracy test

conclusion.thread_speed_result: No consistent end-to-end benefit from 2 or 4 threads across scheduling modes; 4-thread means are slower in every mode, but system background/swap variability limits causal attribution.
conclusion.scheduling_result: CPU-preparation overlap at 1 thread has lowest observed mean (33.05s); full overlap at 1 thread 33.84s; broad ranges prevent a stable winner claim.
conclusion.memory_result: Sampled summed MPS driver allocation peaks 6.38-6.45GiB; system paging is active. This does not indicate the Qwen MPS allocation cap is binding.
conclusion.waiting_result: Existing MPS-to-CPU blocking intervals, explicit synchronization and application queue waits measured; exact Metal scheduler queue latency unavailable. CPU consumer queue waits average 0.24-1.31ms per job, suggesting preparation supply is not the bottleneck on this clip.
conclusion.quality_result: Qwen vectors, 73 text query results and 5 registered-face results exact in all runs. At 2/4 threads OWL has 10681 vs10678 regions; 8/9 image video Top5 order unchanged; helmet_small swaps duplicate content media40/45. Same-thread outputs exact across all9 runs.
conclusion.numerical_followup: Fixed-pixel CPU fast processor independently differs by at most 7.15e-7 at2/4 vs1 threads. Three-frame mean processing time18.17/9.24/7.27ms. This local speedup is not an end-to-end speedup.
